description: Closed 2026-09-11 — no model qualifies. Inventory (token refs in app/, routes/, views, factories, seeders; tests excluded) against the ADR rule (>=90% of refs inside one module, <5 other modules): best candidates are ExternalSecretStore 84% Secrets, OrganizationBillingSnapshot 79% Billing, BillingSubscriptionSyncEvent 77% Billing, EdgeAccessLog 77% Edge, EdgeSiteAccessRule 76% Edge, OrgSecretKey 76% Secrets; ~60 others are mostly/entirely shell/kernel. They miss because the workspace UI lives in the shell by design. Owner chose to close rather than lower the bar. Re-run the inventory before reopening.
title: Move qualifying leaf models into their modules
